propositions: Link emission (ADD via _diff_links and REMOVE via _diff_link_removals) must apply the same effective link_map config to both paths, composing override link_type with built-in swap behavior, with NO hardcoded RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK reference in emission code

Config-aware REMOVE attribution must recover relation from overridden remote vendor type via inverted link_map, stopping spurious adoption of remapped links that built-in JIRA_LINK_TO_RELATION does not recognize
Skip override ('skip' value) must suppress BOTH ADD and REMOVE symmetrically—never added, never removed, never approximated—preserving unsynced relations the same way

Undeclared link-type values in link_map must fail closed at config validation time via effective_link_map calling MappingLayer.validate() with Capability.has_link_types, raising MappingConfigError, not silently passing through
One shared _resolve_link(relation, links, link_map) helper must unify link resolution logic for both ADD and REMOVE, eliminating dual implementations and ensuring ADD/REMOVE consistency

Test coverage must verify the full round-trip: config override changes ADD type and REMOVE attribution; skip suppresses both; undeclared types are rejected; no config block leaves behavior byte-for-byte unchanged
